purpose: Falsify first study without choosing new strategy parameters
notes: Subperiods restart with 100000; they are historical robustness checks, NOT unseen out-of-sample folds.
Delayed stop means a daily-low breach exits at the next available opening, not yesterday's stop price.
Delayed execution can improve or worsen PnL. It is a latency scenario, not a guaranteed lower bound.
Excluded asset allocation remains cash; no reranking into other groups or leverage.
Operating cost is a post-hoc cash drag estimate, not a trading-account rerun.
No model training, whole-universe selection, minute execution certification or production deployment is authorized by these results.
